name: Speedcubing Year End 2016
information: Registration fee (Inclusion: certificate of participation and raffle entry) starts at Php 300.00 for the first 3 events and Php 50.00 additional fee for each additional event. Payment-first system shall be implemented before WCA registrations can be approved and included on the official list of registered participants. Registration closes on November 20, 2016 so please pre-register and settle your payments on or before that date. Strictly no walk-in registrations on the day of the event.
